Gap rows (fitness-functions.md 60-66): YC-7 watched via S4 plus two alerts on staging; post-build vulnerabilities accepted until production; own-database-only accepted (checklist asks; per-service roles later); 63-64 add check when built; 65 app watched; 66 later ADRs.

The map is updated when a check or ci.yml job changes, when an ADR adds or builds an attribute, and once a quarter with the governance review; a check costing more to keep than its risk is not automated, recorded under Chưa có.

Trade-offs among gap choices: a check catches a problem in the change that causes it but only for what it states; watching sees the running system after the fact; accepting costs nothing ongoing until its reason stops being true.

When an attribute can be stated exactly, add a check in the same work that builds the decision; when a per-change check would need a running system and stable timing, watching can be cheaper; when an accept reason stops being true, choose again.
A check started by time rather than by a change is the kind that sees a vulnerability published after the build.
